description:
About Amperos

Amperos is healthcare's first AI-native denial management and revenue recovery platform. Our agentic AI works claims end-to-end, from portal follow-ups and payor calls to appeals and medical records, so providers can resolve more denials, recover more revenue, and focus on what matters most: serving patients.

We just closed a $16M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with continued participation from Uncork Capital and Neo. We're still small, still early, and going after a $260B+ problem that's only getting worse. If you want to work on hard problems that matter, alongside people who care deeply about the mission (and each other), we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Insurance Eligibility Specialist with 2 to 4 years of experience in medical billing and RCM to join our team. You’ll work at the intersection of traditional billing workflows and cutting-edge AI, helping our customers confirm coverage up front so claims are clean, patients know what they owe, and fewer dollars are lost to avoidable denials.

You’ll be responsible for verifying patient insurance coverage and benefits, confirming active eligibility before services, identifying coordination of benefits issues, and updating patient records with accurate payer information. As our product and customer base evolve, your responsibilities may shift to align with near-term priorities. This is a role with meaningful ownership and room to grow.

What you’ll do

  • Verify insurance eligibility and benefits through payer portals, clearinghouses, and phone calls before scheduled visits

  • Confirm coverage status, plan type, effective dates, copays, deductibles, coinsurance, and out-of-pocket amounts

  • Check authorization and referral requirements and route them to the right team

  • Identify primary, secondary, and tertiary coverage and flag coordination of benefits conflicts

  • Update patient insurance details accurately in customer PM systems and Amperos platforms

  • Flag inactive, terminated, or incorrect coverage and escalate with clear notes so the front office can reach the patient

  • Review eligibility-related claim rejections and denials, correct the root cause, and route for resubmission

  • Track recurring eligibility errors by payer and customer, and share patterns with the team

  • Maintain organized documentation of every verification and follow-up

What we’re looking for

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in medical billing, insurance verification, or patient access

  • Strong working knowledge of eligibility and benefits transactions (270/271), plan types (HMO, PPO, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial), and coordination of benefits rules

  • Experience with leading PM systems, including NextGen, ModMed, Athenahealth, and more

  • Hands-on experience with payer portals and clearinghouse eligibility tools

  • Solid understanding of authorizations, referrals, and how eligibility errors turn into denials

  • Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable in documentation and follow-through

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including calls with payers

  • Ability to work US hours (9am to 6pm ET) to collaborate with our team and customers

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes and priorities can change

Our Values

  • Lead with Empathy - Great products and teams are built on empathy—whether for our customers, users, or team members. We take the time to walk in others' shoes, listen actively, and truly understand their challenges, needs, and perspectives.

  • Humbly Ambitious - We combine humility with ambition. No task is beneath us, and no challenge too big. Greatness comes from being willing to do whatever it takes, while having the courage to take bold risks and learn from failures.

  • Radical Agency - Own your domain. Drive initiatives with autonomy and accountability. Think deeply, communicate with the team, and maintain a bias for action.

Amperos never asks candidates for money at any stage of the hiring process, including fees for interviews, processing, or recruitment. No one at Amperos, or acting on our behalf, is authorized to request payment. If you are asked for payment, please do not send any money and report it confidentially here: Report a Hiring Concern
